Reads the buffer pointer at this+0x5C and clears this+0x58 to 0, then frees the buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf at the header-adjusted address (pointer - 4) when it is non-null and clears this+0x5C to 0. Reads the buffer pointer at this+0x68, clears this+0x64 to 0, then frees it when non-null and clears this+0x68 to 0. Finally reads the list node pointer at this+0x54, and when non-null removes it with DoublyLinkedListNodeRemovalByPointer and clears this+0x54 to 0. Returns the last removal result (or the node pointer when it was null).
